notes: Desktop bus-powered USB capture device; no rack mounting and no separate power inlet — power (5V, 4W max) is delivered entirely over the USB-B connector, so that single port carries both data and power. USB connector confirmed as USB 3.0 (USB 3.2 Gen 1) Type-B from AJA's U-TAP manual; grade set to usb-5g per that generation's SuperSpeed 5Gbps spec (device is also compatible with USB 2.0/3.1/3.2 host interfaces per spec sheet, but the native device interface is USB 3.0 Gen 1). SDI In and SDI Loop Out are both 3G-SDI (SMPTE-259/292/424) per the spec sheet, so both are graded sdi-3g. No HDMI on this SKU (that is the separate U-TAP HDMI model).

ports.name: USB
ports.note: USB 3.0 (USB 3.2 Gen 1) Type-B; also delivers bus power to the device (5V, 4W max) — no separate power connector exists
